added_failures_note: derived with reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs over the reviewed run's own two arm logs -- negative-control-base.log (base arm, pytest) and gate-head.log (head arm, pytest) -- because the manifest records baseline_suite and after_suite as prose, so annotate_review_of_run over those fields returns unmeasured; head reports no failing test the base arm does not, so the added-failure count is a measured 0.

2.reason: the coordinator measures the merge delta with its own importer population, which records the suite arms in the shape the reader takes

findings.text: blocking: the publish grace is reached only when no .in-use exists, so a tree that a peer host has just published and pinned but not yet renewed is protected by neither branch -- it fails the grace (an .in-use is present) and fails the lease clause at :93 (no .lease marker yet) -- and a pruner on another host, whose flock is node-local, takes its exclusive lock and removes the tree; that reopens the cross-host loss §44 exists to close, since the incident it fixes is a same-instant reload storm where every host publishes a tree at once.

follow-on: refresh_materialized_tree_pin now touches <root>/.lease, which raises FileNotFoundError when the tree directory has been removed, whereas the pre-change os.utime(descriptor, None) succeeded on the still-open lease inode; a follower whose tree is pruned from under it now raises from the SIGALRM-tick poll instead of continuing on the unlinked directory, which ends the watch stream rather than degrading.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest records baseline_suite and after_suite as prose rather than the bare-path shape reckon.crew.review reads, so the record's added-failure annotation over the manifest fields is unmeasured and a reader cannot tie the reviewed run's suite delta to a log without opening the run directory by hand.
